title: Local Credential Manager credentials
whyItMatters: Saved web, network and app credentials for this Windows account. Someone with the disk could take these blobs offline and try to decrypt them.
source: DPAPI and Credential Manager reference: https://www.windowsforensics.app/en/artifacts/dpapi-credential-manager (blobs under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/Credentials)
notes: DPAPI-encrypted blobs in per-SID subfolders. Metadata only; no blob is opened or decrypted. Roaming copy is a separate rule.

cleanup.exportFirst: Change or write down the passwords these saved credentials hold, because Credential Manager cannot export them.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the Microsoft account, work account and apps that saved credentials on this PC before removing them.
steps: Open Credential Manager from the Start menu and select Windows Credentials.
Remove each saved credential you no longer need.
Do not delete the folder named in the plan by hand; removing entries in Credential Manager is enough, and the full reset clears the rest.
cleanup.risk: Removes saved web, network and app sign-ins for this Windows account; apps that saved them will ask for the password again.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Credential Manager in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/credential-manager-in-windows
